verdict.rationale: OpenHands sells commercial Cloud and Enterprise plans, so plan-based usage limits are a fair question for this product. However, the pricing evidence lists only hosted access, API support, SSO and bring-your-own-LLM-key support, with no mention of daily task quotas or concurrency limits, or any way to view or manage them. Running tasks in parallel with asyncio.gather is an SDK coding pattern, not a plan-based limit, so it does not count here.
